purpose: Record explicit approval of Bella MXF audio Sample Rate rules before reviewing Bit Depth.
status: Approved requirements; no runtime implementation or cutover.

authorization.source: Direct human approval in the current conversation
authorization.statement: OK, let's lock those audio Sample Rate rules in for Bella. Next, how do Media Composer, MDVX and MediaMuster read Bit Depth from MXF, and what should Bella read and keep?
authorization.scope: Approves the preceding focused audio Sample Rate rules. New Bit Depth mappings/coverage and audio source priorities remain separate work.

agreedBellaRules.source: Qualified physical file own supported sound descriptor GenericSoundEssenceDescriptor.AudioSamplingRate, inherited by supported modern WaveAudio/AES3Audio. Preserve Avid property name AudioSamplingRate internally; Sample Rate is the audio table heading.
agreedBellaRules.encoding: Complete known eight-byte big-endian rational, original positive signed32 numerator/denominator. Preserve legitimate uncommon fractions; no Unicode decoding.
agreedBellaRules.unavailable: Missing, damaged, conflicting, unsupported, unsafe ownership or distinguished0/1 supplies no MXF audio frequency. Keep physical file/independent facts; blank if no eligible source supplies it. No guessed48k, whitelist or replacement clock.
agreedBellaRules.separateMeaning: Do not substitute Duration unit rate, Track.EditRate or Preface.ProjectEditRate, multiply by channel count or apply the MDB video NTSC interpreter. Keep video Sample Rate and audio Frame Rate blank.
agreedBellaRules.retention: One exact numeric record and necessary availability, using small new C++17/Qt helpers. Generate any compatibility integer at its boundary, release temporary bytes/reference structures; no permanent duplicate whole-Hz source fact.
agreedBellaRules.displayAndSort: Late familiar kHz labels, including48kHz/44.1kHz/96kHz, and numeric sorting. Shared exact fraction comparison is suitable; uncommon fractional label precision remains the existing presentation follow-up.
agreedBellaRules.readBoundary: Extract during independently required header parsing. No new dependency, essence decode or frequency-only consistency graph. Audio source precedence/read triggers remain for final priority-table review.

evidenceBoundary: Five reused WaveAudio48000/1 observations. No claim of actual AES3/non48k/damaged-value coverage or native GUI parity. Native internal publication alternatives are not raw-property recovery rules.
